role.zh: 全栈开发 / AGENT 开发 / 算法工程 / FDE
role.en: Full-stack Developer / Agent Developer / Algorithm Engineer / FDE

intro.zh: 我是 Kuz，关注 AI 与真实业务之间的最后一公里。从全栈产品、Agent 工作流到算法实验，我把需求、数据、交互与交付连在一起。持续探索 RAG，让知识成为下一步行动的上下文。
intro.en: I'm Kuz. I focus on the last mile between AI and real-world work. From full-stack products and agent workflows to algorithm experiments, I connect requirements, data, interactions and delivery. I continue exploring RAG as a bridge from knowledge to action.

tagline.zh: 让内容流动，让结果可追溯。
tagline.en: Content in motion. Outcomes in view.

summary.zh: 把新闻采集、AI 内容处理、筛选去重、栏目投递与异常核查接成一条可运营的生产流水线。
summary.en: A production workflow connecting news collection, AI-assisted processing, filtering, deduplication, channel delivery and incident review.

role.zh: 全栈开发 · 工作流工程 · 发布与运维
role.en: Full-stack development · Workflow engineering · Release operations

problem.zh: 多来源内容与多目标栏目之间，人工搬运、重复投递和模糊回执会放大运营成本。
problem.en: Multiple sources and destinations create manual work, duplicate delivery and ambiguous receipts.

solution.zh: 通过 FastAPI、Vue 3 和持久任务队列组织 API、调度与 Worker；把投递对象、重试记录和接收证据连成可核查链路。
solution.en: FastAPI, Vue 3 and a persistent task queue coordinate APIs, scheduling and workers. Delivery targets, attempts and receipt evidence stay traceable.

outcome.zh: 形成有正式部署记录的新闻生产平台，支持异常中心、受控数据浏览与可回退发布；接收与客户端展示分别核验。
outcome.en: A documented production deployment with incident review, controlled data inspection and reversible releases. Receipt confirmation and client display are verified separately.

status.zh: 已部署 · 持续迭代

evidence.zh: README 与 STATUS 记录正式部署、发布回退、测试及真实接收证据。本页未重新巡检生产；历史 UNKNOWN 与客户端展示验收仍单列。
evidence.en: README and STATUS record deployment, rollback, tests and actual receipt evidence. This portfolio did not recheck production; historical unknown receipts and client-display acceptance remain separate.

tagline.zh: 让 AI 拥有上下文，也拥有边界。
tagline.en: Context for AI. Boundaries for trust.

summary.zh: 面向长期使用的个人知识与工作证据系统，把 Markdown 资产、Agent 工作流、持续归档与可审计回执组织起来。
summary.en: A long-lived knowledge and work-evidence system connecting Markdown assets, agent workflows, continuous archiving and auditable receipts.

role.zh: Agent 工作流设计 · 知识治理 · Python 自动化
role.en: Agent workflow design · Knowledge governance · Python automation

problem.zh: 对话、任务与项目记录分散，AI 摘要容易失去来源，长期记忆也容易把推测当事实。
problem.en: Conversations, tasks and project records fragment context; summaries can lose sources and memory can confuse inference with fact.

solution.zh: 建立渐进式读取入口、来源与敏感级别、采集租约、原子写入、周期重建和人工内容保护，并用测试约束工具行为。
solution.en: Progressive context entry points, source and sensitivity metadata, execution leases, atomic writes, period rebuilding and protected human edits constrain the workflow.

outcome.zh: 形成可持续维护的 Agent 协作底座：事实、摘要、计划与完成证据各有归属，失败与部分覆盖可被追踪。
outcome.en: A maintainable foundation for agent collaboration where facts, summaries, plans and completion evidence remain distinct, with traceable failures and partial coverage.

status.zh: 工具链已实现 · 持续维护

evidence.zh: 已读取系统运行手册并核对 tools/os_pipeline.py、tools/archive_run.py。此案例是 Agent 协作与知识治理，不宣称已部署向量 RAG。
evidence.en: Read the operating guide and inspected tools/os_pipeline.py and tools/archive_run.py. This is agent collaboration and knowledge governance, not a claim of deployed vector RAG.

name.zh: 桌面数字人 · 讲解与交互

tagline.zh: 把讲解变成可编排的体验。
tagline.en: Turn narration into an orchestrated experience.

summary.zh: 将透明悬浮数字人、语音讲解、节点工作流和桌面/网页交互整合进 Windows 桌面应用。
summary.en: A Windows application combining an overlay avatar, speech narration, node-based workflows and desktop/web interaction.

role.zh: 桌面全栈开发 · 交互编排 · 现场适配
role.en: Desktop full-stack development · Interaction orchestration · Field adaptation

problem.zh: 大屏讲解不仅需要播放声音，还需要让节点、目标按钮、形象状态和讲解节奏同步。
problem.en: Display narration needs more than audio: nodes, target controls, avatar state and timing must work together.

solution.zh: Electron 与本地 Node 服务承载透明窗口和管理端；SQLite 保存配置，TTS 支持缓存与回退，节点串联点击、高亮、讲解和等待。
solution.en: Electron and a local Node service host the overlay and management UI; SQLite persists configuration, cached TTS supports fallback, and nodes coordinate clicks, highlights, narration and waits.

outcome.zh: 已有版本化安装与归档材料，支持节点、节点组、方案及工作流管理；目标大屏、DPI 与声音设备仍按现场环境验证。
outcome.en: Versioned installer and archive materials accompany node, group, plan and workflow management. Target displays, DPI and audio devices require environment-specific validation.

status.zh: 桌面软件 · 现场适配

evidence.zh: 依据源码架构说明与 src/tts.cjs；AI 标签指神经语音服务集成，不表示自研语音模型、3D 数字人或 LLM/RAG 对话。
evidence.en: Based on the architecture record and src/tts.cjs. The AI tag refers to neural TTS integration, not a custom speech model, 3D avatar or LLM/RAG conversation.

tagline.zh: 让复杂业务，回到清晰流程。
tagline.en: Bring complex operations into focus.

summary.zh: 围绕企业案件台账、诉讼阶段、附件、办理节点与权限申请，构建一套业务导向的内部法务工作区。
summary.en: An internal legal workspace for enterprise case records, litigation stages, attachments, milestones and access requests.

role.zh: 前后端开发 · 业务建模 · 数据台账
role.en: Frontend & backend development · Domain modelling · Data records

problem.zh: 不同企业、案件与阶段的资料分散在表格和附件中，检索、协作与过程追踪难以统一。
problem.en: Records distributed across entities, cases, spreadsheets and attachments make search, collaboration and progress tracking difficult.

solution.zh: 将企业、案件、阶段、附件和费用组织为业务模型，用 Vue 页面与 Flask API 承载检索筛选、台账导入导出和操作时间轴。
solution.en: Entity, case, stage, attachment and fee models drive Vue screens and Flask APIs for search, spreadsheet exchange and operation timelines.

outcome.zh: 把内部法务场景转化为可维护的管理系统源码与字段文档；生产版本、权限细节与线上验收以项目记录为准。
outcome.en: Translates an internal legal workflow into maintainable management-system code and field documentation; production state, authorization details and acceptance follow project records.

status.zh: 企业内部场景 · 源码核对

name.zh: 高光谱 · 图平滑与波段选择

tagline.zh: 从高维数据，找到有用信号。
tagline.en: Find useful signals in high-dimensional data.

summary.zh: 围绕高光谱遥感分类，将超像素、空间邻接图、图传播、谱聚类选带与分类评估连接成实验工程。
summary.en: An experimental pipeline connecting superpixels, spatial graphs, propagation, spectral-clustering band selection and hyperspectral classification.

role.zh: 算法实验 · 数据处理 · 结果分析
role.en: Algorithm experiments · Data processing · Result analysis

problem.zh: 高光谱影像维度高且存在冗余，比较方法时还需要处理数据划分、参数、消融与结果口径。
problem.en: Hyperspectral imagery has high dimensionality and redundancy; fair comparisons also require clear splits, parameters, ablations and metric definitions.

solution.zh: PCA 构造输入，SLIC 建立区域，再进行固定图传播与波段选择；通过 SVM/SAM、参数扫描和消融组织评估。
solution.en: PCA inputs feed SLIC regions, fixed graph propagation and band selection; SVM/SAM, parameter sweeps and ablations structure evaluation.

outcome.zh: 保留多组实验脚本与历史结果，为算法对照和复现提供清晰入口；固定传播并非可训练 GCN，历史指标不冒充新复现实绩。
outcome.en: Experiment scripts and historical outputs support comparison and reproduction. Fixed propagation is not a trainable GCN, and archived metrics are not presented as fresh results.

status.zh: 科研实验 · 结果归档

evidence.zh: 依据 2026-10-30 读取的仓库说明整理；具体运行与验收范围见项目文档。
evidence.en: Curated from repository documentation read on 30 Oct 2026; see project records for runtime and acceptance scope.

tagline.zh: 从用户旅程，到完整业务模型。
tagline.en: From user journeys to a complete domain model.

summary.zh: 本科软件工程毕业设计，围绕买家、商家和管理员三种角色，串联商品、溯源、购物车、订单与售后。
summary.en: An undergraduate software-engineering capstone connecting products, provenance, carts, orders and after-sales flows across buyers, merchants and administrators.

role.zh: 全栈开发 · 三端交互 · 业务建模
role.en: Full-stack development · Three-role UX · Domain modelling

problem.zh: 交易流程跨越多个角色，商品审核、订单状态和售后操作需要一致的数据与交互设计。
problem.en: Transactions span multiple roles, requiring consistent data and interaction design for product review, order states and after-sales actions.

solution.zh: 用 Spring Boot、MyBatis 与 MySQL 建立后端，以 Vue 3、Pinia 和 ECharts 实现买家前台、商家工作台和管理端。
solution.en: Spring Boot, MyBatis and MySQL support the backend; Vue 3, Pinia and ECharts implement the storefront, merchant workspace and admin console.

outcome.zh: 形成三角色交易工程及 17 张业务表的结构说明；支付为模拟流水，物流由商家手工登记。
outcome.en: A three-role marketplace codebase with documentation for 17 business tables. Payments are simulated and shipping details are entered manually.

status.zh: 毕业设计 · 全栈工程

evidence.zh: 依据 2026-10-30 读取的仓库说明整理；具体运行与验收范围见项目文档。
evidence.en: Curated from repository documentation read on 30 Oct 2026; see project records for runtime and acceptance scope.

tagline.zh: 探索图像、声音与文本的共同表达。
tagline.en: Explore a shared representation of image, sound and text.

summary.zh: 通过网页接收图像、音频和文本，投影为特征向量，经注意力融合后展示统计、热力图与模态相似度。
summary.en: A web prototype projects image, audio and text inputs into feature vectors, then visualizes attention-based fusion, statistics and similarity.

problem.zh: 多路输入的形状、预处理和融合结果需要可观察的实验界面。
problem.en: Different input shapes, preprocessing steps and fusion outputs need an observable experimental interface.

solution.zh: Flask 承载输入与结果，PyTorch 实现四头注意力和 MLP，Canvas 展示热力图。
solution.en: Flask handles input and output, PyTorch implements four-head attention and an MLP, and Canvas renders heatmaps.

outcome.zh: 已形成端到端结构原型；网络没有训练权重，随机文本嵌入不能当作语义理解或有效评估结论。
outcome.en: An end-to-end structural prototype; untrained networks and random text embeddings do not establish semantic understanding or valid evaluation.

name.zh: 密度峰值选带 · SVM 研究

tagline.zh: 把算法比较，变成可追溯实验。
tagline.en: Make algorithm comparisons traceable.

summary.zh: 用于论文研究的高光谱波段选择与分类实验，整理数据准备、固定划分、方法对照和历史分类报告。
summary.en: Hyperspectral band-selection and classification experiments for paper research, covering data preparation, fixed splits, method comparisons and archived reports.

problem.zh: 不同选带方法与波段数的实验容易混淆来源、参数与评价口径。
problem.en: Comparisons across selection methods and band counts can lose track of sources, parameters and metric definitions.

solution.zh: 组织密度峰值、信息量与聚类等方法，以固定参数 RBF-SVM 对照，保存波段索引、指标与混淆矩阵。
solution.en: Organizes density peaks, information-based methods and clustering with fixed-parameter RBF-SVM comparisons, band indices, metrics and confusion matrices.

outcome.zh: 建立算法与结果归档；DP 指密度峰值，已有结果不代表本轮重训，也不声称优于全波段基线。
outcome.en: A traceable algorithm and result archive. DP means Density Peaks; archived outputs are not fresh training or proof of superiority to the full-band baseline.

tagline.zh: 把阅读体验，带到本地网络。
tagline.en: Bring digital reading to the local network.

summary.zh: 面向 Windows 局域网与阅读终端，提供 PDF/EPUB 阅读、书库管理、读者资料和批注相关界面。
summary.en: A Windows LAN reading system with PDF/EPUB views, library management, reader profiles and annotation-related interfaces.

problem.zh: 本地阅读终端需要统一书库、管理入口与可恢复的安装资料。
problem.en: Local reading terminals need a shared library, management interface and recoverable installation materials.

solution.zh: Vue 3 与 TypeScript 组织阅读端及管理端，Flask/SQLAlchemy 提供服务，SQLite 和本地文件保存内容。
solution.en: Vue 3 and TypeScript organize reader and admin interfaces; Flask/SQLAlchemy provide services, with SQLite and local files storing content.

outcome.zh: 现存多版安装材料与完整归档索引；当前源码确认不替代客户现场安装和阅读流程验收。
outcome.en: Existing installer variants and archive indices support handoff; source review does not replace on-site installation and reading-flow acceptance.

tagline.en: Turn repetitive operations into deterministic workflows.

summary.zh: 读取新闻列表，按栏目与关键词筛选，经三层去重后调用发布接口，配套网页控制台、任务与回退记录。
summary.en: Reads news lists, matches channels and keywords, applies three layers of deduplication and calls publishing APIs, with a console, tasks and rollback history.

problem.zh: 重复筛选、跨来源重复内容和发布后追踪增加日常运营负担。
problem.en: Repetitive filtering, cross-source duplicates and post-publication tracking add operational work.

solution.zh: Python/FastAPI 编排关键词匹配、来源 ID/正文哈希/标题去重、定时执行和最近一轮回退。
solution.en: Python/FastAPI orchestrate keyword matching, source-ID/body-hash/title deduplication, scheduling and latest-run rollback.

outcome.zh: 形成可在 Mock 模式演示的自动工作流；采用规则匹配，不是机器学习推荐或 RAG。
outcome.en: A workflow demonstrable in Mock mode; uses rule matching rather than machine-learning recommendation or RAG.

tagline.zh: 从数据开始，连接视觉模型。
tagline.en: Start with data. Connect to vision.

summary.zh: 个人开发的桌面图像标注工具，支持矩形、多边形、类别管理、项目保存与多格式导出。
summary.en: A personal desktop annotation tool with rectangles, polygons, class management, project persistence and multi-format export.

problem.zh: 视觉模型的数据准备需要一致的标注编辑和标签格式转换。
problem.en: Vision-data preparation needs consistent annotation editing and label-format conversion.

solution.zh: 基于 PySide6 提供画布、缩放和平移，使用项目 JSON 组织标注并导出 YOLO、COCO、VOC 和 LabelMe。
solution.en: PySide6 supplies the canvas, zoom and pan; project JSON stores annotations for YOLO, COCO, VOC and LabelMe export.

outcome.zh: 实现五类格式的导出逻辑与项目往返；属于 AI 数据工具，尚未完成全部 GUI 与训练工具兼容验收。
outcome.en: Implements five export formats and project round trips. An AI data tool; full GUI and downstream training-tool acceptance remain separate.

tagline.en: Make the training entry point clear.

summary.zh: 封装目标检测数据准备、train/val 切分、设备选择、训练参数与最佳权重归集。
summary.en: Wraps object-detection data preparation, train/validation splitting, device selection, training parameters and best-weight collection.

problem.zh: 训练命令、目录约定和运行产物分散时，实验交接容易遗漏关键参数。
problem.en: Scattered commands, directory conventions and outputs make it easy to lose key experiment parameters.

tagline.zh: 连接图像处理与数据工程。
tagline.en: Connect image processing with data engineering.

summary.zh: 提供 PyQt5 预览与 Python 批处理入口，对目标检测图片执行翻转、亮度、对比度和噪声等增强。
summary.en: PyQt5 preview and Python batch tools apply flips, brightness, contrast and noise transforms to object-detection images.

problem.zh: 批量图片增强需要可观察的处理参数，并关注图像与标签的一致性。
problem.en: Batch augmentation needs visible parameters and attention to image-label consistency.

solution.zh: 以桌面预览、参数控制、目录配对和批量输出组织数据增强流程。
solution.en: Desktop preview, parameter controls, paired directories and batch outputs structure augmentation.

outcome.zh: 已有增强与框标签处理代码；中心裁剪标签未重算的限制已明确记录，不能直接当作合格训练集。
outcome.en: Augmentation and box-label logic exist; the documented crop-coordinate issue means generated data cannot automatically be treated as training-ready.

name.zh: 视觉数据准备与推理工具集

tagline.zh: 把零散的数据步骤组织起来。
tagline.en: Organize the steps around vision data.

summary.zh: 六个独立脚本覆盖图片重命名、缩放、压缩、方形填充，以及 PT/ONNX 模型推理可视化。
summary.en: Six scripts cover image renaming, resizing, compression, square padding and PT/ONNX inference visualization.

problem.zh: 模型实验前后的文件整理与输入处理，往往占用大量重复操作时间。
problem.en: File organization and input preparation create repetitive work around model experiments.

solution.zh: 通过 Python、Pillow 与 ONNX Runtime 分开实现文件处理和推理检查入口。
solution.en: Python, Pillow and ONNX Runtime provide separate file-processing and inference-inspection entry points.

outcome.zh: 形成图像处理工具集；不包含人工标注器，原标注坐标也不会随所有图像变换自动同步。
outcome.en: A set of image-processing tools, not an interactive annotation editor; existing label coordinates are not automatically synchronized with every transform.

tagline.zh: 让视觉推理走进实时界面。
tagline.en: Bring vision inference into a live interface.

summary.zh: 自主学习软件，将摄像头取流、人脸/眼睛检测与预训练属性模型集成到实时预览窗口。
summary.en: A self-directed learning application integrating camera input, face/eye detection and pretrained attribute models in a live preview.

problem.zh: 视觉算法需要与摄像头、预处理和界面绘制共同工作。
problem.en: Vision methods must work with cameras, preprocessing and UI rendering.

solution.zh: OpenCV Haar 检测返回区域，InsightFace 处理首张人脸，窗口叠加框与结果。
solution.en: OpenCV Haar detectors locate regions; InsightFace processes the first face, with boxes and outputs rendered in the window.

outcome.zh: 完成模型调用与视频界面集成练习；无身份库、自产模型或经验证的识别准确率。
outcome.en: An exercise in model integration and video interfaces; no identity database, self-trained model or verified accuracy claim.

tagline.zh: 从像素到交互反馈。
tagline.en: From pixels to interactive feedback.

summary.zh: 通过 dlib 标志点、OpenCV DNN 年龄区间推理和 Tkinter 摄像头窗口探索桌面视觉交互。
summary.en: Explores desktop vision interaction with dlib landmarks, OpenCV DNN age-range inference and a Tkinter camera view.

problem.zh: 底层模型输出需要转化为可理解的桌面反馈。
problem.en: Low-level model outputs need understandable desktop feedback.

solution.zh: 连接摄像头、68 点预测器、Caffe 模型和伪彩图绘制，形成单窗口处理链路。
solution.en: Connects a camera, 68-point predictor, Caffe model and pseudo-color rendering in one interface.

outcome.zh: 保留视觉集成实验代码；模型未随库提供，颜色与像素规则不作为医学结论。
outcome.en: Preserves vision-integration experiment code; models are not bundled and color/pixel rules do not support medical conclusions.

name.zh: 遥感影像分类桌面原型

tagline.zh: 让算法流程，可以看见。
tagline.en: Make algorithm workflows visible.

summary.zh: 将 TIFF 加载、波段选择、降维、多种分类器和指标可视化整合到桌面原型。
summary.en: A desktop prototype combining TIFF loading, band selection, dimensionality reduction, classifiers and metric visualization.

problem.zh: 遥感实验中的图像、真值、算法参数与结果容易分散在多个脚本。
problem.en: Images, ground truth, algorithm settings and results are often scattered across scripts.

solution.zh: 使用 PyQt5 组织多页工作区，连接 rasterio、scikit-learn 和可选分类依赖。
solution.en: PyQt5 organizes a multi-page workspace connected to rasterio, scikit-learn and optional classifier dependencies.

outcome.zh: 形成算法工作台原型与 HTML 报告入口；界面指标不作为独立测试集成绩。
outcome.en: An algorithm-workbench prototype with HTML reports; UI metrics are not treated as independent test-set results.

tagline.zh: 让实验数据，更容易表达。
tagline.en: Give experiment data a clearer voice.

summary.zh: 将多 CSV、曲线、独立基线、画布预览和图像导出放进三栏桌面界面。
summary.en: A three-pane desktop interface for multiple CSV sources, series, independent baselines, previews and image export.

problem.zh: 重复改脚本绘图不利于快速对照多个实验结果。
problem.en: Repeated script edits slow comparison across experiment outputs.

solution.zh: PySide6 管理交互，pandas 读取数据，Matplotlib 承载线图、散点、柱图、热图与饼图。
solution.en: PySide6 manages interaction, pandas reads data and Matplotlib supports line, scatter, bar, heatmap and pie views.

outcome.zh: 实现 CSV 科研绘图原型；项目保存与完整样式管理仍有后续空间。

tagline.zh: 把多源表格，转化为共同视图。
tagline.en: Turn multiple tables into a shared view.

summary.zh: 本地桌面工具用于两份井深相关数据的导入、清洗、标准化、公共字段融合与导出。
summary.en: A local desktop tool for importing, cleaning, normalizing, joining and exporting two depth-related datasets.

problem.zh: 不同来源的地学表格需要清晰的清洗规则与共同连接字段。
problem.en: Geoscience tables from different sources need clear cleaning rules and shared join keys.

solution.zh: PyQt5 页面串联 pandas 的缺失值处理、IQR 规则、归一化与精确键连接，并用 Matplotlib 对照曲线。
solution.en: PyQt5 connects pandas missing-value handling, IQR rules, normalization and exact-key joins with Matplotlib curve comparison.

outcome.zh: 形成科研成果展示软件及样例流程；字段连接不等同于空间配准，也不宣称软著已登记。
outcome.en: A research-demonstration application and sample workflow; field joins are not spatial registration, and copyright registration is not claimed.

tagline.zh: 把模型假设，变成可观察过程。
tagline.en: Make modelling assumptions observable.

summary.zh: 一维分层地层桌面原型，提供简化物理剖面、参数反演、异常区间分析和结果导出。
summary.en: A one-dimensional layered-strata desktop prototype for simplified physical profiles, parameter inversion, anomaly intervals and export.

problem.zh: 模型配置、观测拟合和结果图表需要放在同一可观察流程中。
problem.en: Model configuration, observation fitting and plots benefit from a shared observable workflow.

solution.zh: 使用显式经验公式和有界最小二乘，结合 PyQt5 与 Matplotlib 展示配置、模拟和反演。
solution.en: Explicit empirical formulas and bounded least squares combine with PyQt5 and Matplotlib for configuration, simulation and inversion.

outcome.zh: 形成方法演示原型；不是有限元、三维耦合求解器或经现场验证的工程产品。
outcome.en: A method-demonstration prototype, not a finite-element solver, 3D coupled simulation or field-validated engineering product.

name.zh: 人事管理 Web 工程

tagline.zh: 从业务表单，到统计视图。
tagline.en: From business forms to analytical views.

summary.zh: 前后端分离的人事管理学习工程，覆盖员工、部门、手工考勤、薪资记录和统计页面。
summary.en: A decoupled HR learning project with employees, departments, manually entered attendance, salary records and analytics.

problem.zh: 管理页面需要统一处理 CRUD、筛选分页与图表统计。
problem.en: Management interfaces need consistent CRUD, filtering, pagination and charting.

solution.zh: Spring Boot 与 MySQL 提供业务接口，Vue 3、Element Plus 和 ECharts 组织管理体验。
solution.en: Spring Boot and MySQL provide APIs; Vue 3, Element Plus and ECharts organize the management interface.

outcome.zh: 形成管理系统学习工程；登录权限含模拟逻辑，标记发薪不代表真实银行付款。
outcome.en: A management-system learning project; authentication includes mocks and salary-state changes do not make bank payments.

tagline.zh: 把日常管理，组织为业务模块。
tagline.en: Organize day-to-day management into modules.

summary.zh: 覆盖员工、部门、考勤、请假加班、工资记录与培训资料的 Web 工程。
summary.en: A web codebase covering employees, departments, attendance, leave, overtime, salary records and training materials.

problem.zh: 人事信息与工资相关记录需要关联展示和统一维护入口。
problem.en: Personnel and payroll-related records need linked views and consistent maintenance screens.

solution.zh: 以 Spring Boot、MyBatis-Plus 和 MySQL 保存记录，Vue 2/Element UI 提供角色菜单与业务表单。
solution.en: Spring Boot, MyBatis-Plus and MySQL persist records; Vue 2/Element UI provide role menus and business forms.

outcome.zh: 保留较完整的业务模块与字段说明；工资计算和权限边界待完善，不包含真实支付或转账。
outcome.en: Preserves business modules and field documentation; payroll and authorization boundaries need further work, with no real payment or transfer integration.

tagline.zh: 把加密机制，落到文件流程。
tagline.en: Put cryptographic mechanisms into a file workflow.

summary.zh: 实践账号、服务端加密上传、拥有者解密下载、文件元数据和审计页面。
summary.en: A practical implementation of accounts, server-side encrypted uploads, owner downloads, metadata and audit views.

problem.zh: 文件管理需要同时考虑数据存储、密钥包裹与拥有者关联。
problem.en: File management must consider storage, key wrapping and ownership together.

solution.zh: Flask/SQLAlchemy 编排业务，AES-GCM 加密文件，PBKDF2 派生密钥并包裹文件密钥。
solution.en: Flask/SQLAlchemy orchestrate the workflow; AES-GCM encrypts files and PBKDF2-derived keys wrap file keys.

outcome.zh: 形成服务端加密存储实践；不具备端到端或零知识保证，完整权限与运行验收仍需完善。
outcome.en: A server-side encryption practice project; it does not provide end-to-end or zero-knowledge guarantees, and authorization/runtime acceptance need further work.

tagline.zh: 把一张表，拆成清晰交付物。
tagline.en: Turn one worksheet into clear individual outputs.

summary.zh: 读取 Excel 工作表，将每条非空数据行排版为独立 JPEG，支持工作表、字体和图片质量选项。
summary.en: Reads an Excel worksheet and lays out each nonempty row as an individual JPEG, with sheet, font and quality options.

problem.zh: 逐人制作工资条图片存在重复复制和排版工作。
problem.en: Creating individual payslip images involves repetitive copying and layout work.

solution.zh: openpyxl 读取数据，Pillow 绘制表头、网格和文字，CLI 控制输入与输出。
solution.en: openpyxl reads the sheet, Pillow draws headers, grids and text, and a CLI controls input and output.

outcome.zh: 虚构工作簿导出检查已在项目记录中完成；只处理排版，不计算薪资或自动发送真实工资条。
outcome.en: Project records document synthetic workbook export checks; the tool formats data, without calculating payroll or sending real payslips.
